name: Phosphor Glass
description: Dark navy glass over a real blur that behaves like a phosphor screen. Bright content behind the surface excites a glowing response in the brand gradient, and the glow breathes like phosphor persistence. A slow diagonal sweep recharges the pane as it passes. Where nothing sits behind the surface it falls back to a translucent navy slab with the same shimmer. The Content opacity parameter sets how much of the window content stays visible over the glass.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Blur radius
parameters.description: Strength of the backdrop blur (px). Past a display scale of 125% the top of the range stops adding blur, and the lowest setting is already a soft blur rather than none

parameters.name: Corner radius
parameters.description: Roundness of the pane corners (px, 0 for square)

parameters.name: Content opacity
parameters.description: How visible the window content stays over the pane, where 1.0 is fully opaque and 0.0 shows only the phosphor glass

parameters.name: Tint strength
parameters.description: How far the blurred scene sinks toward the glass tint

parameters.name: Glow strength
parameters.description: Brightness of the excited phosphor response

parameters.name: Excitation threshold
parameters.description: How bright the backdrop must be before the glass glows

parameters.name: Hue flow speed
parameters.description: How fast the gradient hue drifts through the pane

parameters.name: Sweep speed
parameters.description: How fast the recharge sweep travels the pane. At 0 the sweep and the phosphor's slow breathing both stop, so the glass sits still

parameters.name: Gradient cyan
parameters.description: First stop of the brand gradient

parameters.name: Gradient blue
parameters.description: Second stop of the brand gradient

parameters.name: Gradient purple
parameters.description: Third stop of the brand gradient

parameters.name: Gradient rose
parameters.description: Fourth stop of the brand gradient

parameters.name: Glass tint
parameters.description: The surface colour the blurred scene sinks toward

parameters.name: Round bottom corners
parameters.description: Round the bottom corners as well as the top. Turn off to round only the top two. The Border, Glow and Drop Shadow packs always round all four, so turning this off in a chain that also holds one of them leaves their rounded bottom over this pack's square one

parameters.name: Edge softness
parameters.description: Anti-alias feather of the pane edge, in device pixels, so it does not grow with display scaling. Lower is crisper

parameters.name: Brightness
parameters.description: Gain on the blurred scene. 1.0 leaves it as captured

parameters.name: Contrast
parameters.description: Contrast of the blurred scene around mid grey. 1.0 leaves it as captured

parameters.name: Saturation
parameters.description: Colour saturation of the blurred scene. 0 is greyscale and 1.0 leaves it as captured

parameters.name: Noise
parameters.description: Fine grain over the blur that hides banding in smooth gradients

parameters.name: Vibrancy
parameters.description: Boosts saturation where a colour is already saturated and bright, so muted scenes stay muted. 0 turns it off, and Vibrancy darkness widens it to darker colours

parameters.name: Vibrancy darkness
parameters.description: How far the vibrancy boost reaches into darker colours. Does nothing while Vibrancy is 0, which is where it starts
